title: A value removed in Solusi is still in ServiceNow
cardHint: A value Procurement removed in Solusi stays in ServiceNow, because the import never clears a field. SACM clears it by hand.
cardText: The import from Solusi never clears a field (procedure 2.8, known challenge 2). A value that Procurement removed in Solusi stays in ServiceNow until SACM clears it by hand. An old end date matters most: ServiceNow shows the contract as Expired because of it.
subject: contract
